subject.title: boot-md hook re-runs BOOT.md on every gateway restart

question: Should bundled boot-md remain a per-gateway-startup checklist, or should OpenClaw change BOOT.md to a run-once workspace initialization lifecycle with explicit reset semantics?
rationale: Current code and docs intentionally describe per-startup execution, while the requested fix would add persistent state and change existing user-visible hook behavior.

options.title: Keep per-startup BOOT.md
options.body: Document the current contract as intentional and close or redirect run-once initialization to a separate setup/onboarding surface.

options.title: Adopt canonical run-once lifecycle
options.body: Change boot-md to record completion/reset state in canonical OpenClaw state, preserve boot-session isolation, and update docs/tests for upgrade-safe behavior.

options.title: Add explicit opt-in mode
options.body: Keep per-startup as the default and add a maintainer-approved run-once mode only if the extra configuration surface is worth the compatibility cost.

recommendation.title: Adopt canonical run-once lifecycle
recommendation.body: Change boot-md to record completion/reset state in canonical OpenClaw state, preserve boot-session isolation, and update docs/tests for upgrade-safe behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the original boot-md gateway-startup feature and are the clearest history-backed owner for deciding whether its lifecycle contract should change.
